summary: Skillful Craftsman Education Technology, a Nasdaq-listed Cayman holding company, agreed on October 10, 2026 to acquire 70% of Singapore-based URAY PTE. LTD. from Liu Qingwu, who retains 30%. Consideration is 500,000 restricted ordinary shares issued to the seller, with restrictions lapsing at one year, plus a 2,500,000-share earn-out pool for URAY management tied to three-year revenue and EBITDA targets, and up to US$2 million in 7% unsecured shareholder loans in two tranches. Closing, subject to Nasdaq and securities-law approvals and a 60-day outside date, consolidates URAY. Watch share-count dilution and tranche-two revenue trigger.
